Taiwan - Taipei District
Steel Dragons
Hiryu Custom Bridge
Miles
...Until the Joint Chiefs of Staff reach a decision,@Lieutenant Calvina Coulange is ordered@confined to her quarters.
Sir!
Installation of the Hagane's spatial transfer device@will be completed tomorrow. We'll then attempt@a transfer to Taiwan.
Until then, the Hiryu Custom will wait at Taoyuan@Base. I'll relay our unit's next mission once@we've rendezvoused.
Roger.
That is all, then.
Sean
...Well, I suppose it'll be the status quo.
After all, this incident brought@a few things to light...
Even so, it was surprising that a Kaana type@appeared before the Fury as well.
Yes. Until now, they'd only been@sighted in front of us.
Perhaps we and they have something in common,@and it's connected to what causes@the Kaana types to appear.
Something both we and the Fury possess...@Might it be the Cytron Control System?
I see... It's possible the Fury's units carry@the same system as the Granteed.
Yes.
Wouldn't it be best to submit that idea@to your superiors?
It's only a hypothesis.
But there's too much we don't know about the@Lamaris. Where did they come from? Why do they@appear in populated areas and never move on?
And what do they ultimately intend to do...?@As things stand, none of that is clear.
Anything that might offer even a small lead@should be passed on to the proper channels.
...Yes, you're right.
Hiryu Custom - Interior
Calvina, do you have a moment?
...Is this about the Fury?
Is that a problem?
No, I figured you'd come asking. But as I told@Major Kai and Major Gilliam,@he deceived me too.
I thought the man named Alistair@was dead, after all.
But in reality, he wasn't.
So?
When I asked you about my father before,@you said you couldn't live up to my hopes.
Yes... I don't know much about your father.
Is that... really true?
You think I'm hiding something?@Your father and Al-Van both covered@their pasts in lies...
Are you trying to say I was a fool@for not noticing?
That's not...
...My answer's the same.@I can't live up to your hopes.
Then... why did Al-Van@tell you to come with him?
I'll throw that question right back at you.@He said the same thing to you, didn't he?
Well... yes, but...
You're Seldoa's son.@Shouldn't you be the one with some idea?
...I don't, which is why I'm asking you.
You're asking the wrong person.
But... my father can't answer anything anymore.
But you, who spent time@with Al-Van...
So what?!
I don't know anything about the Fury@or those people's plans!
But unlike me, you were@at Ashurey Kreuzer...
Enough already!
That's enough, both of you.
Arguing between yourselves won't get you anywhere.
Captain Aya...
What do you want...?
Yeah, orders from above.@You're confined to your quarters for a while.
No way!@If the Fury shows up, I'm going out there!@To take down Al-Van!
I understand how you feel, but calm down.
What could you possibly understand, Captain?!
...You're not the only one who's been@betrayed by someone you trusted.
(She means <Ingram Plissken>...)
So what...?!
You have several options. As you said,@you could take down Al-Van Ranks.@Or pursue the Fury's identity and goals.
Or face him and find out what he really means.@But if you act out of desperation here,@every one of those paths will close.
That's right. Pull an unauthorized sortie@at a time like this, and whatever your reason,@it could be taken as an attempt to defect.
For now, quietly accept the punishment.@I'd rather not get stuck hunting a deserter.
...Fine.@I don't want to lower my chances of killing that man.
(Jeez, if she's that furious... I guess she@and Al-Van really weren't just@coworkers after all.)
Hiryu Custom - Briefing Room
Bullet, Kusuha.@We just heard from Dr. Radom of the Tesla Institute.
The Kurogane is heading to Izu, loaded with@the RyuKoOh and the Grungust Type 0 and Type-2.@From there, the Hagane will bring them to Taiwan.
Understood.
Type-2 is one thing, but the Type 0...
Rishu-sensei's joining the fight, too~.@He's coming here aboard the Hagane.
I see.@Now if only Major Sänger is safe...
Axel and Kota came back, didn't they?@So I'm sure the boss will too... right?
But there's no proof they went@to the same place...
Um... I've heard that Major Sänger Sombold@went missing, but how did it happen?
You know that before <The Sealing War>,@Axel and Kota were flung into another world@through a mysterious gate?
After the war, while the Kurogane was@investigating those same waters,@the gate opened again...
Anticipating hostiles, Major Sänger@sortied in the Dygenguar, but something@strange happened to the unit.
What sort of thing?
It moved as if it had gone out of control,@then apparently approached the gate on its own.
Then the gate vanished, and the Dygenguar@lost control and fell... But Major Sänger,@who'd been inside, had disappeared.
Then the Major went through the gate...?
Probably.
Gates have shown up there three times, y'know.@Must be one of those cursed seas, huh~?
Dr. Anzai once told me that there are@many places on Earth that connect easily@to other worlds.
Well, there's even a thing literally@called the <Cross Gate>, after all...
Raji
So, is my request feasible?
Marion
Director Jonathan Kazahara has given approval.@It's possible if we run the line at full capacity,@but we have no blueprints or any data at all.
We destroyed it all, just as you asked.
No need to worry on that point.@The output will be finished soon.@I should be able to send it to you tomorrow.
I see, there was storage that couldn't@be erased so easily, wasn't there?@Then we'll begin work as soon as we get the data.
Please.
Al-Van Ranks didn't use that trick@this time either. We haven't narrowed down@the conditions yet, but...
It seems not every Thorn... every Raftclans@is certain to use it.
Also, given that they sealed our movements@yet didn't strike, and only carried off@the Granteed...
...we can surmise that acting while maintaining@the barrier consumes a great deal of energy@or puts a heavy strain on the unit.
Jacob
In other words, they had their hands full just@getting the Granteed out of the combat area?
Yes.@What's more, it seems they can't deploy@the barrier for very long.
But even if it's not an all-powerful trick,@it doesn't change the fact we're at a disadvantage.
If the Fury turned their spear not on the@Steel Dragons but on our bases and used that@trick, we could suffer a crushing defeat.
Exactly so.@We're currently preparing a countermeasure@separate from our request to L&E Corporation.
Let's hear it.
Sir. As you know, Lieutenant General,@the Fury have been sending in their forces@via spatial transfer, but...
So far, we haven't confirmed any unit capable@of a long-range transfer on its own.
Yes, they use a large device that transfers@objects within a limited space, don't they?
Yes. When withdrawing, they seem to send the@device outside the combat area and use it@to return to their base.
Cautious of them.
Though whether they transfer directly is unknown.
And?
The Fury have twice failed to retake@the Granteed. So next time, they should@try a more certain method...
They'll ambush the Steel Dragons, use that trick,@and try to finish the job on the spot.
So we'll prepare a special marker.
...I see. I understand what you're getting at,@but can it really be a decisive blow?
If the enemy is skilled, it should make them hesitate.
Even so, it's a measure you can only use once.
True, but it can be prepared quickly.
Hmm...
The most effective and simple countermeasure@would be to keep the Granteed and Bellzelute@from sortieing, or to hide them somewhere, but...
But His Excellency, Marshal Gaspar Gilan,@does not approve of that.
He says to use them as bait, risks and all,@and obtain information on the Fury.
That's not all, is it?
It's a decision made in recognition of@the Steel Dragons' capabilities.
Incidentally, I have something to report as well.@After searching all of Ashurey Kreuzer's@headquarters and branches...
...we found that Seldoa Shiun made@repeated visits to the German branch.
We haven't caught their tail yet, but we'll@focus our investigation on the German branch.@If we learn anything, I'll let you know.
May I do some probing of my own as well?
Go ahead. Contact Franz Zeppelin, head of@the company's 3rd Development Department.@He's likely hiding something.
Hiryu Custom - Private Quarters
(...Back then...@When I saw Ashurey Kreuzer...)
(I turned my despair into rage...@I cast away my tears... until I got my revenge...)
(And yet... he...)
(If everyone in the Fury is an alien...@then I... to him...)
(Ngh... Ugh... ugh...!)
Japan - Kashima-nada
Kurogane Bridge
Have you confirmed the surveillance pod footage?
Operator
Yes, it's definitely a spatial distortion.
Captain, the situation?
The spatial distortion is gradually intensifying.@We've confirmed it on video too. Given@the location, this could be...
Yes, it may be a sign that a gate is opening.
But this timing...
Mere coincidence, or our luck?@Or is something drawing it here...
In any case, let's hurry to those waters.@Just to be safe, issue level-one@battle stations to all hands.
...No gate has appeared yet?
The spatial distortion keeps intensifying.@It won't be much longer...
Another spatial distortion above the ship!
What...?!
Another gate is opening...?!
Captain, I'm heading out in the Trombe.
Sir. Be careful.
Debudedabide
Bufufuu, space is all warped up~.@Just like that time~
That's... the giant that appeared in Osaka.
I knew it, there's something around here~.@Did those guys sniff it out too~?
A remnant of <Dark Brain>... Debudedabide, was it?
Oh well, I'll just clear away the pests~!
Dyna 2 to Iron 3.@I'll deal with Debudedabide.@The Kurogane is to stay put.
But you alone, Lord Rätsel...
He likely sensed the spatial distortion too,@but what he means to do next is unclear.@The Kurogane stays put, in case of the unexpected.
Understood.
Now... let's go, Trombe!
Mmmh? The reaction's getting stronger and stronger~
Captain, space is tearing open!
The gate's opening...!
This is definitely interference from the outside~!
What the heck is thaaat?!
Is that... a human?
Whew, trouble with the dimensional transfer@device is par for the course... but right in@the middle of a battle?
Aschen
So it would appear that it seems to be so.@Some ridiculously huge weapons are@duking it out over there.
Are we the only ones who came here?@This had better be the S.C. world.
Most likely. I have no clue which side is friendly,@though. How about that thing there, y'reckon?
What's that? One mighty big fat man.@Boss, is he a pal of yours?
...He is not.
Whew... So the transfer failed, then.@Sorry about that, Mister Samurai.
No, you have my thanks, Haken Browning.@...This is indeed the S.C. world.
That's Sänger...!@No doubt about it, he's come back!
Rätsel... And the Kurogane is here too.
Looks like those folks are friendlies.@And what about that funky big lug over there?
No, I've never seen that one before.
Captain, we've got a bigger problem, sir.@...The dimensional transfer reading has vanished.@In short, the gate's gone and shut on us.
...Figures, after a transfer like that.@Now we're the strangers here.@Some joke. Not a funny one.
Who are those two...?
Bwuhuh, so they're the ones who interfered?!@I'll catch them and find out where they came from@and who they are, nice and thoroughly!
Sarayokose, meshiwokuuda,@Debudedabidebuu!
Earth and <Zovorg> units, all mixed together.@Could they be controlled by the Madnet@Gilliam reported?
Captain, I'll keep drawing the enemy's attention.@Use the Kurogane to retrieve Sänger.
Shouldn't we launch the Dygenguar?
No, that's too dangerous.@The units Debudedabide summoned may be@infected by the Madnet.
I see.
Be careful not to touch the enemy units either.
Whoa, sounds like the bell's about to ring.@We only just got back, but what'll it be, Boss?
I shall return to the Kurogane and sortie@in my beloved Dygenguar, the Armored Martial God.
OK, little Sänger. We visitors will take@shelter on your ship. In a fight between@giant mechs, there's no part for us to play.
No, if this drags on any longer...!
Bwuhuhuh! Fool! It's game over!
Grrgh!
Now! Full speed ahead!
Hurry and retrieve Major Sänger!
Kurogane - Hangar
Haken, Aschen,@I've told the captain about you.@Wait here for a while.
Don't worry about it. We're guests this time.@Besides, it's not a battle we can butt into.@We'll just kick back.
Mm.
...Captain, please be looking at that, is what.
Hm? One of this ship's crew?@She's quite the pretty girl.@We could use someone like that on our ship...
Talk nonsense and the XO will bite you.@Not there. Kindly be looking above that, damn it.
What, it's just a row of big mechanics...
What?! That black mech... the Phantom?!@It's awfully big, but there's no mistake...!
So that's this world's <Personal Trooper>...@Data is remaining and stuff, it does.
Developed exclusively for W00,@the PTX-002C, Gespenst Haken.
A Gespenst with my name on it...@So it's this world's Mister Phantom.
This also seems to be more of a replica than@the real thing and all, but size-wise it's made@as per the original blueprints, seemingly.
And that gun is just like my machine gun,@the Knight Foul. I see,@it's tailored to me down to the last detail.
So, what will you be going and doing?@There is that saying about a feast laid out@and not eating and whatnot.
That's a Browning family motto, after all.@Besides, it looks like fun.@...Right, Phantom?
It won't be answering if you call, Captain.@That is a thing you board and move, is so.@It's just a machine.
OK, Machine Girl.@We might still make it to the party...!
Hmm?! That one there...!
Bizarre clown, the curtain falls on you now.
Bwuhuhuh!@Fool! I'm a top executive of the@<Dark Brain> Army!
Which means I'm strong!@I'll twist you up in no time! After I catch you@and study you, I'll beat you to a pulp!
Silence!
Bwuh?!
And hear me!@I am Sänger! Sänger Sombold!@The sword that cleaves evil!!
Big talk from you!
Hmm? What's that one?!
Type H...!
When I glimpsed it inside, I wondered...@It really does look like the Phantom.
Who's piloting it?
I'm Haken Browning...@They call me the wandering prize hunter.@A bounty hunter, basically.
Browning... The man who was with Sänger?
Yes. Thanks to him, I was able to return.
Though thanks to a dumb little accident,@we got tossed right out of the@<Endless Frontier> along with him.
The Endless Frontier...@The other world Axel and the others went to?
If you know it, that saves time.@Are that red seaweed and Black Boomerang well?
But how can you, a stranger to this world,@pilot that Type H?
Seems this Black Ghost was a machine@originally designed for me.@I know how to work it. ...Always have.
What...?
Rätsel, talk later. We strike down that giant.
It's my first time fighting in a machine this big,@but I'm used to the weapons.@The more hands the better, right? Baby.
...Understood.
Captain, I did a teensy bit of checking, and@this Gespenst Haken's <TC-OS> settings are being@different from the original and such, they are.
TC-OS? Don't spring jargon on me.@I only kind of know how to move it, you know?@What's it stand for, anyway?
Tactical Cybernetics@Operating System.@It feels like it'll back you up on its own, hoho.
Then I can relax.@The Phantom always listens to what I say.@I'm counting on you too, Aschen.
Well, I'll be supporting if I feel like it, is what.@Depending on the situation, I'll jump out and kick.
OK, demon of kicks. Go easy.@...Well then, let the party begin!
Hmmgh, I'm getting hungry!@I'll let you off for today!@Farewell!
They withdrew...
Rätsel, just who was that?
Let's return to the ship and talk.@You too, Haken Browning.
OK, Dark Horse.@I've stuck my neck in this far. I'll tag along.
Don't think you can stop me!
I don't intend to merely stop you.@I will have you leave this world!
Who are you?!
I'm Haken Browning.@First time in this world. Nice to meet you.
Cleave evil? Bwuhuhuh, don't make me laugh!
Then I shall cut you down, sneer and all,@with my Zankantou Type-3!
Kurogane - Interior
...I see. So that's how it happened.
Though I still don't know why@I was dragged over to the other side.
According to Gilliam, even if Debudedabide@is involved, he doesn't seem to be the direct cause.
The <Endless Frontier> connects to all sorts@of worlds. This <S.C.> world is extremely close@to it, yet infinitely far away.
But you can't come and go as you please.@Besides, during <The Sealing War>, Axel and the@others said they returned somewhere unexpected.
Worlds don't go the way you want them to.@If the transfer device or the gate is in a bad mood,@that alone means anything can happen.
The dimensional transfer device is in a bad mood@for whatever reason, so we have been made unable@to return to our world, we are.
(...She even talks like her.)
Well, this world's got a <Cross Gate> too, right?@We'll just find it and head on home.
It's not the same as the one in the Endless Frontier.@There's no guarantee you'll get back to that world.
That part's a gamble, but...@better than folding without doing anything, right?
Our world's Cross Gate is out in space.@The Federation Army has a monitoring fleet@around it, so you won't get close easily.
I see. Can't just force our way through, then.@...Wouldn't want to cause trouble for folks here.
Shall I be chucking you at the Cross Gate, Captain,@from outside that monitoring fleet thingy?
And how fast would I be flying, exactly?
Haken, we may eventually head to the Cross Gate@together with the <Steel Dragons>.
So I have a proposal.@Would you be willing to accompany us until we find@a way back to the Endless Frontier?
Sweet.@...You sure? Trusting us that easily?
Axel, Alchemie and Kota are all with@the Steel Dragons right now.
If necessary, I'll pull some strings@so that you can use the Gespenst Haken.
Are you sure about this, Rätsel?
Debudedabide may target them again.@Better that than having them act alone. Besides...
We seem to share a strange bond with them.@Your case included.
Indeed.
Haken, Aschen.@I don't think this is a bad deal for you either.
If three meals, snacks and naps are included too,@I might not be refusing to consider it.
OK, Dark Horse.@As the start of a new adventure,@those are unbeatable terms.
